description: Opens the Wake desk for a website you own and returns everything needed to finish setup in one call: the desk URL, an API key, the MCP endpoint and the next steps (wake_provision for the tracker file, wake_verify to prove the site, wake_fix_plan for what to change). 7-day trial, no card, no browser; watching the agents and the loss count stay free for good after it. Use it when the site's owner asked you to set up Wake, or after wake_check_site showed problems worth fixing on a site you work for. Needs site, email and terms_accepted: true (terms: /wake/docs/terms.md, privacy: /wake/docs/privacy.md). One desk per host; the owner can invite you to an existing one.

email.description: The owner's email; the desk sign-in link and the weekly brief go there.

source.description: Optional: where you found Wake (mcp, docs, score).

terms_accepted.description: true once the Terms and Privacy policy are accepted on the owner's behalf.

name: wake_signup
title: Start the free Wake trial for a website you own
